title: Multimodal AI biomarker predicts recurrence in stage I lung adenocarcinoma
summary: PATH-ORACLE combines a transcriptomic score with histology features from pretrained foundation models to predict recurrence in stage I lung adenocarcinoma. The abstract reports accuracy above 85% in two independent international cohorts and outperformance of IASLC grading. Cohort sizes were not stated in the abstract, and this is a preprint.
ai_technology: Multimodal deep learning combining histology foundation-model features with a transcriptomic score
organization: Department of Physics of Complex Systems, Eotvos Lorand University, Budapest, Hungary; Boston Children's Hospital, Harvard Medical School, Boston, USA

evidence.tested: Recurrence prediction in two independent cohorts against grading and single-modality models.
evidence.unknown: Cohort sizes, calibration and benefit for adjuvant therapy selection; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A multimodal deep-learning model combined slide images and gene expression to predict recurrence.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from the review input and author affiliations from Crossref metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
